pages.title: The Four Seasons
pages.summary: A band of travelers whose paths have become entwined with the fate of kingdoms, moonlight, and shadow.
pages.body:
# A name forged on the road
The **Four Seasons** is the name the adventurers chose in [[Kestrel Ford]], after surviving a far longer journey that began near [[Port Llast]]. Their story has crossed kingdoms, the sea, and even the [[Shadowfell]].

## The adventurers
The founding travelers were [[Bramwell Elixor]], [[Luna]], [[Bjorn]], and [[Fenwick]]. As the story grew, companions such as [[Amel]], [[Princess Yulia]], [[Brick]], and [[Estephan]] joined them along the road. [[Fenwick]] later departed the traveling party, though he remains part of its history.

## Friends, uneasy allies, and foes
The company's path has intertwined with [[Jimsko]], [[Flynn]], [[Velka]], and [[The Pirate Queen]]. New faces continue to appear as they travel, including [[Cinder]] in [[Thamor]].

## Follow their story
Explore the [[Campaign Chronicle]], open the **Session Journal** from the top navigation, or visit the **World Atlas** to trace their recorded journey.

> Four different paths. One story beneath the moon.

pages.title: Campaign Chronicle
pages.summary: A player-friendly record of the travels and turning points of The Four Seasons.
pages.body:
# A chronicle of the road
## Saga I — The daughter of the moon
Four travelers arrived in [[Port Llast]] and investigated the [[Port Llast Lighthouse]], then recovered the [[Moon Scroll]] in the [[Caverns of Lior]]. Their quest led them through [[Neverwinter]], [[Neverwinter Wood]], and [[Luskan]], where [[Jimsko]] was rescued and the mystery of the [[Moonfall Vault]] emerged.

Through the vault they entered the [[Shadowfell]] and traveled to [[Blackreach]], seeking a way back to the Material Plane. Their battle against the Unforgotten gave the [[Keeper]] time to open a [[Shadow Crossing]], and the adventurers returned to a wheat field beneath open sky.

Every Saga I session is recorded individually in the **Session Journal** (Sessions 1–17), based on the party's own recaps.

## Saga II — A name and a crown
The travelers reached [[Kestrel Ford]], where their company became [[The Four Seasons]]. After further travel they entered [[Thamor]], met [[Cinder]], and attended [[King Arven I]]'s knighting ceremony in [[Crown Square]]. There, an attempted attack disturbed the celebration and [[Bramwell Elixor]] blocked an incoming arrow.

*Only played events are recorded here. The next chapter is waiting to be written.*

pages.title: Bramwell Elixor
pages.summary: A human cleric of Helm whose convictions have drawn both admiration and controversy.
pages.body:
# The watchful hand
**Bramwell Elixor** is a human cleric devoted to [[Helm]]. A practiced alchemist as well as a priest, he has walked a difficult line between faith, responsibility, and what he believes to be right.

Bramwell became known for his efforts to help those afflicted by a terrible plague. That work, and the choices surrounding it, have complicated his relationship with religious authority.

## Travels
A founding member of [[The Four Seasons]], Bramwell has journeyed through [[Port Llast]], [[Neverwinter]], and [[Thamor]]. During the knighting ceremony in Thamor, he reacted to an arrow aimed into the gathering.

## Known connections
- [[Helm]] — god of guardians and vigilance
- [[The Four Seasons]] — his companions
- [[Luna]] and [[Bjorn]] — fellow adventurers

pages.title: Luna
pages.summary: A wanderer whose story is still unfolding, with strange dreams and ties to the world of the fey.
pages.body:
# A life written in questions
**Luna** travels with [[The Four Seasons]]. Mysterious dreams, unusual encounters, and the pull of the fey have followed her adventures.

Once known for her roguish talents, Luna's journey has taken her toward strange magic and a personal history that is not yet fully understood.

## On the road
Luna has traveled alongside [[Bramwell Elixor]] and [[Bjorn]] through [[Port Llast]], [[Neverwinter]], and the lands around [[Thamor]].

## A living entry
More of Luna's history will be added as it becomes part of the shared campaign story.

pages.title: Bjorn
pages.summary: A towering goliath barbarian, formidable in battle and loyal to his companions.
pages.body:
# Strength on the road
**Bjorn** is a goliath warrior and a member of [[The Four Seasons]].

A son of [[Jimsko]], Bjorn carries his strength and resolve through each hard-won adventure, from the shores near [[Port Llast]] to the roads beyond [[Neverwinter]].

His story is closely entwined with those of [[Bramwell Elixor]], [[Luna]], and their fellow travelers.

pages.title: Fenwick
pages.summary: A gnome druid, also known as Xero, who once traveled with the company.
pages.body:
# The druid of the wilds
**Fenwick**, sometimes called **Xero**, is a gnome druid and a former traveling member of [[The Four Seasons]].

His familiarity with the natural world brought a different outlook to the group during their journeys. His road has since separated from the company’s, though his part in their history remains.

See also: [[Campaign Chronicle]].

pages.title: Jimsko
pages.summary: A dwarf with longstanding ties to the adventurers and an especially personal stake in Bjorn’s journey.
pages.body:
# The dwarf called Jimsko
**Jimsko**, also known as **Jimmy Jim**, is a dwarf whose path crossed that of [[The Four Seasons]] in [[Port Llast]].

He is the father of [[Bjorn]]. Familiar to the adventurers from their earliest travels, Jimsko helped introduce [[Estephan]] to the company.

For all the great affairs of kings and gods, Jimsko is a reminder that this adventure began among ordinary people.

pages.title: Princess Yulia
pages.summary: A spirited princess of Neverwinter with silver hair and striking moonlike eyes.
pages.body:
# The princess of Neverwinter
**Princess Yulia** is a member of the royal family of [[Neverwinter]]. Her silver hair and moonlike eyes have made her memorable to those who have met her.

Despite royal expectations, Yulia is known for her lively spirit, willingness to speak her mind, and concern for the people beyond the palace walls.

Her story has begun to intersect with that of [[The Four Seasons]].

pages.title: King Arven I
pages.summary: The young king of Thamor, trying to wear a crown in an uncertain age.
pages.body:
# A young crown
**King Arven I** rules [[Thamor]] at an age when most children are still discovering who they wish to become.

The king presided over a much-anticipated knighting ceremony in [[Crown Square]], attended by guards, residents, and visiting dignitaries. An attempted attack disrupted the festivities.

## A contested future
Thamor faces outside pressure from [[Mourktar]], while the ominous [[Dragon's Due]] weighs on public conversation. With a child on the throne, every public appearance carries political weight.

pages.title: Cinder
pages.summary: An intriguing figure encountered amid the bustle and politics of Thamor.
pages.body:
# A curious acquaintance
**Cinder** is a figure the travelers met while exploring [[Thamor]]. Conversations with Cinder unfolded against a backdrop of crowded markets and preparations for [[King Arven I]]’s knighting ceremony.

Much about Cinder remains to be learned. This entry will grow as the company discovers more.

pages.title: Grath Erlkar
pages.summary: A veteran leader and first captain associated with Port Llast.
pages.body:
# The first captain
**Grath Erlkar** is a prominent civic figure in [[Port Llast]], known as its First Captain.

Grath's position places him among the townspeople most closely concerned with keeping this northern port functioning amid dangers at sea and ashore.

pages.title: Velka
pages.summary: A dangerous adversary encountered in the caverns near Port Llast.
pages.body:
# The cavern leader
**Velka** led a hostile group encountered in the [[Caverns of Lior]], near [[Port Llast]].

The adventurers overcame Velka and captured their opponent alive during their investigation of the region.

See [[Campaign Chronicle]] for the surrounding events.

pages.title: Wiwi
pages.summary: A fairy whose appearance added a hint of the uncanny to the journey.
pages.body:
# A flicker of fairy light
**Wiwi** is a fairy known to [[The Four Seasons]].

Not every story in the company's travels belongs to castles and grand designs. Some arrive on small wings, carried by the erratic magic of the fey.

pages.title: Brick
pages.summary: A crab companion who has become a small but memorable part of the group.
pages.body:
# The smallest adventurer?
**Brick** is a **crab** companion of [[The Four Seasons]].

Lacking the stature of [[Bjorn]] or the spellcraft of [[Bramwell Elixor]], Brick nevertheless deserves his place in the adventuring record.

*Yes, Brick is a crab.*

pages.title: Estephan
pages.summary: A mouse familiar and an unusual addition to the adventuring company.
pages.body:
# A tiny fellow traveler
**Estephan** is a mouse familiar introduced to [[The Four Seasons]] through [[Jimsko]] during their time in [[Port Llast]].

A diminutive companion in a world of towering monsters and towering egos, Estephan has earned an entry of his own.

pages.title: Port Llast
pages.summary: A northern coastal settlement where the party’s adventures began.
pages.body:
# Where the sea meets the story
**Port Llast** lies on the northern [[Sword Coast]]. To travelers, it is a modest port town; to [[The Four Seasons]], it is where their common adventure truly began.

## Places to know
- [[The Net & Keg]] — an inn and tavern where stories and rumors mingle
- [[Port Llast Lighthouse]] — a coastal landmark at the center of a disturbing investigation
- [[Caverns of Lior]] — caverns beyond the town, where danger and discovery awaited

## People
Among those connected with Port Llast are [[Grath Erlkar]] and [[Jimsko]].

pages.title: The Net & Keg
pages.summary: A familiar tavern and inn in Port Llast.
pages.body:
# The Net & Keg
The **Net & Keg** is an inn and tavern in [[Port Llast]]. A place of food, talk, and passing travelers, it belongs to the earliest chapter of [[The Four Seasons]]' adventures.

*What tales will the next patron bring through the door?*

pages.title: Port Llast Lighthouse
pages.summary: The lighthouse at Port Llast, whose mystery led the party toward something far larger.
pages.body:
# The light on the coast
The **Port Llast Lighthouse** watches the coastline near [[Port Llast]]. During the party's early investigation, the structure and the nearby shore became the focus of troubling activity.

Beneath the lighthouse, the travelers found an old shrine connected with [[Selûne]]. The discoveries made there helped set them on the trail of the [[Moon Scroll]].

pages.title: Caverns of Lior
pages.summary: A network of dangerous caverns visited during the first leg of the adventure.
pages.body:
# Beneath the earth
The **Caverns of Lior** are a cave system near [[Port Llast]]. During their search for answers, [[The Four Seasons]] entered the caverns and faced [[Velka]] and hostile inhabitants.

The journey through the caverns became one of the defining moments of their earliest adventures.

pages.title: Neverwinter
pages.summary: The celebrated Jewel of the North, a great city on the Sword Coast.
pages.body:
# The Jewel of the North
**Neverwinter** stands among the best-known cities of the [[Sword Coast]]. Its courts, markets, and avenues offer opportunity in equal measure to peril.

[[The Four Seasons]] journeyed here following their adventures at [[Port Llast]]. Among the figures tied to its royal household is [[Princess Yulia]].

## A city of many stories
The city is a place of temples, trade, politics, and countless lives whose stories continue whether or not adventurers are present.

pages.title: Luskan
pages.summary: A hard-edged northern city of ships, intrigue, and competing powers.
pages.body:
# City of Sails
**Luskan** is a northern city on the [[Sword Coast]], known for its ships and formidable reputation.

Its history and rivalries form part of the wider world through which [[The Four Seasons]] travel. Not every secret of Luskan has yet found its way into the party's chronicle.

pages.title: Sword Coast
pages.summary: A long stretch of western Faerûn, home to seaports, cities, and lonely roads.
pages.body:
# Along the western shore
The **Sword Coast** is a region of western Faerûn where major trade cities stand beside old forests, seaside settlements, and dangerous stretches of wilderness.

For [[The Four Seasons]], the road here has connected [[Port Llast]], [[Neverwinter]], and the shadow of [[Luskan]].

The coast's bustle hides many smaller stories in its roadside inns, forgotten shrines, and rocky inlets.

pages.title: Kestrel Ford
pages.summary: A lively road village where the adventurers chose their name.
pages.body:
# The village at the ford
**Kestrel Ford** is a village on the journey toward [[Thamor]]. Its roads carry merchants, local news, and travelers with different reasons to hurry onward.

It was around this stage of their travels that the party took the name [[The Four Seasons]].

Here, ordinary village life briefly offered a contrast to the great affairs waiting in the city ahead.

pages.title: Thamor
pages.summary: A city of blue-and-gold banners, a child king, and uneasy celebrations.
pages.body:
# Under blue and gold
**Thamor** is a crowded city ruled by [[King Arven I]]. Visitors find lively streets, merchants, ceremony preparations, and the constant movement of a city hoping for a stable future.

## The crown and its rivals
Thamor's independence has drawn pressure from [[Mourktar]], while stories of the [[Dragon's Due]] have troubled its residents.

## A public gathering
At [[Crown Square]], the young king's knighting ceremony drew a large crowd and a formidable guard presence. [[The Four Seasons]] witnessed an attempted attack during the proceedings.

The party has also crossed paths with [[Cinder]] in the city.

pages.title: Crown Square
pages.summary: The ceremonial heart of Thamor and the setting of a memorable knighting.
pages.body:
# A square beneath the banners
**Crown Square** is a prominent public gathering place in [[Thamor]]. During [[King Arven I]]'s knighting ceremony, the square thronged with guards, nobles, townsfolk, and visiting spectators.

An arrow and the appearance of assailants cast a sudden shadow over the celebration. [[Bramwell Elixor]] was among those who reacted to the danger.

pages.title: Mourktar
pages.summary: A rival power whose dealings with Thamor have become a topic of concern.
pages.body:
# Beyond Thamor
**Mourktar** is a distant center of power mentioned in connection with [[Thamor]]'s political situation.

The city and its envoys are discussed in the context of competing claims, diplomatic pressure, and the future of [[King Arven I]]'s reign.

What these tensions mean for the adventurers remains to be seen.

pages.title: Blackreach
pages.summary: A place remembered from the party’s travels before they reached Kestrel Ford.
pages.body:
# A road behind them
**Blackreach** is a location in the recent travels of [[The Four Seasons]], before their arrival at [[Kestrel Ford]].

This is a short entry, ready to be expanded with player-confirmed recollections and discoveries.

pages.title: Selûne
pages.summary: The Moonmaiden, deity of moonlight, whose name threads through the campaign.
pages.body:
# The Moonmaiden
**Selûne**, the Moonmaiden, is a deity associated with the moon, guiding light, and those who seek their way through darkness.

A shrine beneath the [[Port Llast Lighthouse]] and the discovery of the [[Moon Scroll]] drew the attention of [[The Four Seasons]] to the goddess and her history.

Selûne's ancient opposition to [[Shar]] lies at the heart of many stories in the world.

pages.title: Shar
pages.summary: The Lady of Loss, a deity associated with darkness and secrets.
pages.body:
# The Lady of Loss
**Shar** is a deity often associated with darkness, loss, and hidden things.

Her legendary conflict with [[Selûne]] is known far beyond temples and ancient manuscripts. The [[Moon Scroll]] has brought echoes of that conflict close to [[The Four Seasons]].

Much remains unknown about what this history may mean for the present.

pages.title: Helm
pages.summary: The Watcher, god of guardians, duty, and vigilance.
pages.body:
# The Watcher
**Helm** is the god of watchfulness and guardianship, revered by those sworn to stand between danger and the people they protect.

[[Bramwell Elixor]] serves Helm as a cleric, although questions of doctrine and duty have not always led him down the easiest path.

pages.title: Moon Scroll
pages.summary: An ancient scroll whose discovery changed the direction of the party’s journey.
pages.body:
# A recovered mystery
The **Moon Scroll** is an ancient document recovered during the early adventures of [[The Four Seasons]]. The party's investigation of the [[Port Llast Lighthouse]] and [[Caverns of Lior]] placed the scroll at the center of their journey.

The writing has been connected with ancient Netherese language and with the histories of [[Selûne]] and [[Shar]].

## What remains unknown
Its full implications are not yet part of the public chronicle. This entry records only what the travelers have learned.

pages.title: Dragon's Due
pages.summary: An ominous obligation discussed in connection with Thamor and a red dragon.
pages.body:
# A shadow over the city
The phrase **Dragon's Due** is spoken around [[Thamor]] as a source of apprehension.

It is associated with reports of a powerful red dragon and concerns over the city's security and autonomy. Political tensions involving [[Mourktar]] have only increased uncertainty.

How much is rumor, how much is threat, and how much is politics remains to be discovered by [[The Four Seasons]].

pages.title: How to Use This Wiki
pages.summary: A quick introduction to browsing and contributing to the living campaign encyclopedia.
pages.body:
# Welcome to the Living Atlas
**Daughter of the Moon Wiki** is a player-safe encyclopedia of people, places, and adventures of [[The Four Seasons]].

## Explore
- **World Atlas**: switch between the Sword Coast, Threskel, and the Shadowfell. Click a pin to open the location and its session appearances. Maps are schematic, not precise geography.
- **Connections**: focus any wiki article to see the constellation of related people, organizations, locations, and artifacts.
- **Session Journal**: open each recap or add your own next session.
- **Quest Board**: starts empty. Post a quest during a session and mark it Open, In progress, Completed, or Archived.

## Edit articles and add artwork
Use **Edit this article** or **New entry** to change text, upload a cover or gallery portraits, and add rich internal references such as `[[Neverwinter]]` or `[[Neverwinter|the city]]`. A character gallery is made of images added through the scribe's editor.

## Draw your own routes and links
On the **World Atlas**, choose *Edit map & routes* to add pins for existing articles, position them by coordinates, and create routes. Choose *Move pins* to drag them directly. On **Connections**, use *Edit relationships* to add or remove links between any two entries.

## Publish carefully
Edits save to your browser first, including drafts, quests, map changes, relationships, and session text. Choose **Edit wiki** → **Publish to GitHub** with a repository-scoped editor token when you're ready for players to see them. Other readers don't need any token. Don't paste tokens into content.

**Backups matter:** the editor's Download complete backup command includes images that haven't been published yet. On another browser/device, restore that backup before continuing.

## Player-safe by design
There is no password-protected DM section. Unrevealed plans and backstories must remain outside this public GitHub repository.

pages.title: Neverwinter Wood
pages.summary: A wilderness of hidden paths, an old druid sanctuary, and unlikely meetings.
pages.body:
The company crossed [[Neverwinter Wood]] while keeping [[Princess Yulia]] beyond the city's reach. Here they aided [[Amel]], met the storyteller Volo, and sought a druid sanctuary through old forest signs.

## In the chronicle
See [[Saga I — Session 6: Into the Woods]] and [[Druid Sanctuary]].

pages.title: Druid Sanctuary
pages.summary: A secluded refuge found beyond a cavern guarded by an owlbear.
pages.body:
A crow near a statue of Silvanus pointed the party toward a hidden route through [[Neverwinter Wood]]. Past spiders and an owlbear, [[Fenwick]] entered a sanctuary accessible to those who had spared its guardian.

[[Saga I — Session 6: Into the Woods]] and [[Saga I — Session 7: Road to Luskan]] recount the visit.

pages.title: Flynn's Safehouse
pages.summary: A refuge and meeting place for the party during their time in Luskan.
pages.body:
After meeting [[Flynn]] at a performance in [[Luskan]], the adventurers found temporary shelter at his safehouse. They returned here while navigating the Pirate Queen's demands and the rescue of [[Jimsko]].

The house was eventually compromised. See [[Saga I — Session 10: The Ledger House]].

pages.title: The Ledger House
pages.summary: A suspicious Luskan property where an important rescue took place.
pages.body:
A supposed tax office in [[Luskan]] concealed imprisoned captives. The adventurers infiltrated it at night and rescued [[Jimsko]] and [[Velka]].

See [[Saga I — Session 10: The Ledger House]].

pages.title: Moonfall Island
pages.summary: A moonlit island whose ancient pool opened the way below the sea.
pages.body:
A ruined island and circular pool associated with [[Selûne]]. When the [[Moon Scroll]] was spoken under the moon, the waters opened into a portal toward the [[Moonfall Vault]].

See [[Saga I — Session 12: Beneath the Moon]].

pages.title: Moonfall Vault
pages.summary: A legendary underwater sanctuary reached through a moonlit portal.
pages.body:
[[Jimsko]] spoke of a hidden vault beneath the sea. The party set sail from [[Port Llast]] and reached a portal on [[Moonfall Island]], eventually entering a submerged sanctuary filled with ancient magic, strange creatures, and a ruined shrine of [[Selûne]].

Its depths led into an unexpected journey to the [[Shadowfell]].

pages.title: The Shadowfell
pages.summary: A shadowed plane of lost memories, illusions, and costly passage.
pages.body:
The party was cast into this bleak realm from the [[Moonfall Vault]]. They journeyed across black grass toward [[Blackreach]], where memories could serve as payment and a [[Shadow Crossing]] offered hope of a return home.

Follow the journey in [[Saga I — Session 13: The Shadowfell]] and beyond.

pages.title: Eye of Memories
pages.summary: A mysterious institution in Blackreach said to hold memories and clues to escape.
pages.body:
Within [[Blackreach]], the party sought the Eye of Memories and its priest in hopes of discovering the whereabouts of the [[Keeper]]. Its archive concerned lost memories and the last [[Shadow Crossing]].

See [[Saga I — Session 14: The Eye of Memories]].

pages.title: Forgotten District
pages.summary: A hidden passage beneath Blackreach leading to a remarkable encounter.
pages.body:
With [[Annabel]]'s help, the group entered a secret district under [[Blackreach]] and reached a vast door. Beyond it they finally met the [[Keeper]].

See [[Saga I — Session 17: The Unforgotten]].

pages.title: Crown of Embers
pages.summary: A Neverwinter tavern remembered for a night that descended into chaos.
pages.body:
Some of the party stayed here during their first time in [[Neverwinter]]. One evening's festivities escalated into a tavern-wide brawl.

See [[Saga I — Session 5: The Prophecy]].

pages.title: Wizard's Rest
pages.summary: A scholarly haven visited by Fenwick in Neverwinter.
pages.body: [[Fenwick]] spent an evening here while the rest of the adventurers went to the [[Crown of Embers]]. Later, the party pursued research into the [[Moon Scroll]].

pages.title: Thamor Stables
pages.summary: A stable near the busy streets of Thamor where the party left its horses.
pages.body: The Four Seasons arrived in [[Thamor]] and left their newly purchased mounts here before exploring the city. Crowds had gathered for [[King Arven I]]'s knighting ceremony in [[Crown Square]].

pages.title: Flynn
pages.summary: A resourceful Luskan contact rescued from the caves near Port Llast.
pages.body: The party freed [[Flynn]] from captivity during their first investigations near [[Port Llast]]. He later repaid the favor in [[Luskan]], supplying contacts and a temporary safehouse. He assisted with passage by ship toward the [[Moonfall Vault]].

pages.title: Amel
pages.summary: A quick-thinking adventurer who met the party in Neverwinter Wood.
pages.body:
[[Amel]] fought alongside the company after their encounter with blood hawks in [[Neverwinter Wood]]. He later traveled with them through [[Luskan]] and into the [[Shadowfell]].

He became part of the group's later Saga I history.

pages.title: Vesper
pages.summary: A young person encountered in Luskan who traveled with the company.
pages.body: The party met [[Vesper]] during its stay in [[Luskan]]. She later accompanied the others toward [[Port Llast]], where Vesper, [[Velka]], and [[Princess Yulia]] remained behind during the sea voyage.

pages.title: The Pirate Queen
pages.summary: A formidable power in Luskan who bargained with and manipulated the party.
pages.body:
In [[Luskan]], the adventurers were brought before a pirate queen who offered information and leverage involving [[Jimsko]] and [[Velka]]. The encounter led them to the [[Ledger House]].

Her interest in the [[Moonfall Vault]] placed her in rivalry with the group.

pages.title: Annabel
pages.summary: A lost memory in Blackreach who sought one last moment with her mother.
pages.body: In the [[Shadowfell]], the group met [[Annabel]], a child searching for her mother [[Ariana]]. After they helped reunite the pair, Annabel guided them toward the [[Forgotten District]] and the [[Keeper]].

pages.title: Ariana
pages.summary: Annabel’s mother, living in Blackreach with fading recollections.
pages.body: The adventurers visited [[Ariana]]'s home in [[Blackreach]]. With the help of a family portrait, they briefly restored her memory of her daughter [[Annabel]].

pages.title: The Keeper
pages.summary: An ancient presence the party met beneath Blackreach.
pages.body:
Deep in the [[Forgotten District]], the adventurers encountered the [[Keeper]]. It offered a chance to open a [[Shadow Crossing]], provided the company could protect it through a dangerous ritual.

The confrontation is recorded in [[Saga I — Session 17: The Unforgotten]].

pages.title: Verren
pages.summary: A powerful, enigmatic traveling companion whose path later diverged.
pages.body:
The mysterious wizard traveled with the company during the [[Shadowfell]] chapter and helped them return home. Later, after reaching the Material Plane, he departed to recover memories and regain control of his magic.

Names in the adventurers' retellings vary, including Veren and Varen.

pages.title: Cinder the Fairy
pages.summary: An animated healer introduced to the company in Thamor.
pages.body: The Four Seasons encountered [[Cinder]] in [[Thamor]] during preparations for the young king's ceremony. He was known for flamboyant behavior and healing magic.

pages.title: Lysa
pages.summary: A traveler helped by the company near Kestrel Ford.
pages.body: On their way toward [[Kestrel Ford]], the party helped [[Lysa]] after trouble involving goblins and a flock of sheep. The misadventure became one of the early stories of Saga II.

pages.title: Shadow Crossing
pages.summary: A rare passage between the Shadowfell and the Material Plane.
pages.body: During their stay in [[Blackreach]], the party learned of [[Shadow Crossing]]s that might provide a road home from the [[Shadowfell]]. The [[Keeper]] ultimately helped them open such a passage after they survived a difficult defense.

pages.title: Saga I — Session 1: The Road to Port Llast
pages.summary: Session 1 · Retold by Bramwell · The Road to Port Llast.
pages.body:
## The adventure

[[Bramwell Elixor]], [[Luna]], [[Bjorn]] and [[Fenwick]] met on the road to [[Port Llast]]. A wrecked merchant wagon, a thief and wolves tested the strangers before they encountered [[Jimsko]] at [[The Net & Keg]]. Rumors of a failing [[Port Llast Lighthouse]] drew their attention.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 2: The Flickering Lighthouse
pages.summary: Session 2 · Retold by Fenwick · The Flickering Lighthouse.
pages.body:
## The adventure

At the docks the group met Port Llast’s mayor. With the help of [[Brick]], they investigated the mayor’s home, found a book concerning [[Selûne]], fought shades beneath the [[Port Llast Lighthouse]], and stopped a ritual involving a magical shard at the tower’s top.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 3: The Hidden Cove
pages.summary: Session 3 · Retold by Bjorn · The Hidden Cove.
pages.body:
## The adventure

[[Estephan]] joined the company. They raided a pirate beach camp, destroyed a false lighthouse and entered the [[Caverns of Lior]]. [[Flynn]] was freed; beyond a rune-locked wall they recovered the [[Moon Scroll]], whose magical numbers appeared to count down.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 4: The Price of a Scroll
pages.summary: Session 4 · Retold by Luna · The Price of a Scroll.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The party captured [[Velka]] in the [[Caverns of Lior]]. On returning to [[Port Llast]], they found [[The Net & Keg]] attacked and [[Jimsko]] missing. Faced with a dwindling countdown and warnings about the scroll, they chose to seek answers in [[Neverwinter]] first.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 5: The Prophecy
pages.summary: Session 5 · Retold by Bramwell · The Prophecy.
pages.body:
## The adventure

On the road to [[Neverwinter]], the adventurers met the fairies [[Wiwi]] and Nini. In the city, research yielded fragments of the [[Moon Scroll]]’s prophecy, and the countdown ceased. The group then helped [[Princess Yulia]] escape an escort; she joined their travels.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 6: Into the Woods
pages.summary: Session 6 · Retold by Fenwick · Into the Woods.
pages.body:
## The adventure

Leaving [[Neverwinter]] by forest paths, [[Bjorn]] stayed behind when guards arrived. In [[Neverwinter Wood]], the others rescued [[Amel]], met Volo and found a cavern leading to the [[Druid Sanctuary]] past a dangerous owlbear.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 7: Road to Luskan
pages.summary: Session 7 · Retold by Amel · Road to Luskan.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The adventurers reached the [[Druid Sanctuary]] and continued north to [[Luskan]]. The city quickly introduced them to its thieves, bargains, rumors and new faces, including [[Vesper]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 8: A Play About Us
pages.summary: Session 8 · Retold by Luna · A Play About Us.
pages.body:
## The adventure

Wanted posters in [[Luskan]] accused the travelers of abducting [[Princess Yulia]]. They attended a theatrical parody of their own exploits, met [[Flynn]] there and received an invitation to speak privately. A masked director then confronted [[Bramwell Elixor]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 9: The Pirate Queen
pages.summary: Session 9 · Retold by Bramwell · The Pirate Queen.
pages.body:
## The adventure

An encounter after the play led to imprisonment in a dangerous mansion. The adventurers escaped their cells, found magical items and met [[The Pirate Queen]], who bargained over [[Velka]], [[Jimsko]] and her enemies in [[Luskan]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 10: The Ledger House
pages.summary: Session 10 · Retold by Fenwick · The Ledger House.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The party infiltrated the [[Ledger House]] and rescued both [[Velka]] and [[Jimsko]]. They learned of the [[Moonfall Vault]], but [[The Pirate Queen]] had been listening. With [[Flynn]]’s help, they prepared to sail away from [[Luskan]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 11: To Sea
pages.summary: Session 11 · Retold by Amel · To Sea.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The company returned to [[Port Llast]], then left [[Velka]], [[Vesper]] and [[Princess Yulia]] on land while setting sail. Strange sea creatures attacked their vessel as the party pursued the hidden [[Moonfall Vault]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 12: Beneath the Moon
pages.summary: Session 12 · Retold by Luna · Beneath the Moon.
pages.body:
## The adventure

A moonlit reading of the [[Moon Scroll]] opened the waters on [[Moonfall Island]]. The adventurers entered the [[Moonfall Vault]], fought the Crab Queen and activated a statue of [[Selûne]]. An elder lich appeared and cast them into the [[Shadowfell]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 13: The Shadowfell
pages.summary: Session 13 · Retold by Bramwell · The Shadowfell.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The company awakened in the bleak [[Shadowfell]] and crossed black fields to [[Blackreach]]. Entry required giving up a memory. Among the city’s illusions and unnerving merchants, the party began searching for a [[Shadow Crossing]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 14: The Eye of Memories
pages.summary: Session 14 · Retold by Fenwick · The Eye of Memories.
pages.body:
## The adventure

Seeking a route home in [[Blackreach]], the group visited the library and [[Eye of Memories]], learning of the mysterious [[Keeper]] and the last [[Shadow Crossing]]. The Eye released a hostile creature of stolen voices and memories.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 15: A Missing Memory
pages.summary: Session 15 · Retold by Amel · A Missing Memory.
pages.body:
## The adventure

After surviving the battle at the [[Eye of Memories]], the party searched [[Blackreach]] for an escaped memory. Their investigation turned toward a girl seen earlier in the city, with new signs of strange magic and uncertain allies.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 16: The Girl and the Knight
pages.summary: Session 16 · Retold by Luna · The Girl and the Knight.
pages.body:
## The adventure

The company found [[Annabel]] and learned she could guide them toward the [[Keeper]]. A confrontation with the Black Knight in [[Blackreach]] was abruptly ended by their powerful companion [[Verren]].

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga I — Session 17: The Unforgotten
pages.summary: Session 17 · Retold by The Company · The Unforgotten.
pages.body:
## The adventure

[[Annabel]] was briefly reunited with [[Ariana]] and showed the party the entrance to the [[Forgotten District]]. There they defended the [[Keeper]] from the Unforgotten while it opened a [[Shadow Crossing]]. They escaped the [[Shadowfell]] and awoke in a wheat field on the Material Plane.

## Continue exploring

[[Campaign Chronicle]] · [[The Four Seasons]]

pages.title: Saga II — A Name at the Ford
pages.summary: The company emerges from the Shadowfell and begins Saga II.
pages.body:
## At the table

After returning from the [[Shadowfell]], the travelers and [[Verren]] journeyed toward [[Kestrel Ford]]. Along the road they helped [[Lysa]], encountered goblins and a sheep-related misadventure, and eventually chose a name for their company: [[The Four Seasons]]. [[Verren]] later parted ways with the others to pursue his own recovery.

*This recap covers only events confirmed to have happened in play.*

pages.title: Saga II — A Crown in Thamor
pages.summary: The travelers attend the young king’s knighting.
pages.body:
## At the table

The Four Seasons traveled from [[Kestrel Ford]] to [[Thamor]], stabled their horses at the [[Thamor Stables]], met [[Cinder]], explored the city and attended [[King Arven I]]’s knighting ceremony in [[Crown Square]]. An arrow interrupted the proceedings; [[Bramwell Elixor]] intervened to block the attack. Further commotion surrounded the ceremony. This is the latest publicly recorded chapter of the party’s Saga II travels.

*This recap covers only events confirmed to have happened in play.*

quests.title: THE ASH-REED COURIER
quests.body:
GUILD JOB: THE ASH-REED COURIER / 240 GP TOTAL

Client: Merchants' Exchange, with a small reward supplement from the Guild. 

Location: Reedglass Fen, about two hours east of Thamor's outer orchards; walking route leads past old toll markers.

Objective: Find Dera Sol, an adult courier last seen taking a sealed tribute packet to a local healer called Auntie Veyra. Return Dera alive if possible; recover the packet, notes, or proof of what happened.


Why urgent: Several burned traders bought “dragonfire ward” charms from a seller tied to the fen. One wagon burned despite the charm. Locals say the marks on its axles were made by an actual red dragon.
